name: Peel-Zone Simulated Pressure
formation: Odd Sim Mug vs 11P Gun Trips Right

summary.motive: Manufacture an unblocked 4-man simulated pressure from the slot while utilizing peel rules on the edge defender to eliminate the offense’s primary hot checkdown to the running back.
summary.keyDefender: LOLB (Peel Technique Edge Dropper) & NCB (Sim Creeper Blitzer)
summary.whyItWorks: The offensive line accounts for the edge rusher who bails to cover the running back, leaving no blocker available to pick up the nickel cornerback rushing from depth.
summary.failureMode: A quick seam throw down the hash if the boundary safety is slow to rotate into deep centerfield.

beats.title: 5-Up Simulated Pressure Presentation
beats.text: Todd Bowles aligns in an Odd 5-up mug look with nickel back (NCB) apexed over the weak slot, threatening a boundary overload.

beats.title: The Peel Rule & DB Launch
beats.text: As the running back free releases into the weak flat, edge rusher LOLB executes his "peel" assignment, bailing to blanket the RB, while NCB launches full-speed on an unblocked creeper track past the left tackle.

beats.title: Hot Answer Trapped by Dropping Lineman
beats.text: The QB looks for his quick RB checkdown only to find LOLB in the hip pocket, and DE_R dropping into the intermediate window to take away H.

beats.title: Untouched Blindside Sack
beats.text: With all hot options capped, the unblocked slot corner (NCB) crashes into the quarterback’s blind side for a clean 8-yard sack.

relations.tell: Edge rusher turns outside immediately to match running back release while slot cornerback sprints downhill on blindside track
